content.introduction: The sources provide information on Asian financial markets, including stock indices, commodities, and futures. The Nikkei 225 is at 63,108.00, down 182.11 points (-0.29%); the S&P/ASX 200 is at 8,856.50, down 51.60 points (-0.58%); the Hang Seng is at 23,393.32, up 98.90 points (+0.42%); the Shanghai Composite is at 3,638.03, up 39.01 points (+1.08%); and the BSE Sensex is at 75,692.78, up 1,233.25 points (+1.66%). Gold is at 3,908.25, up 9.35 points (+0.24%). The sources do not provide a definitive answer for some indices as they show different figures for the same indices on different pages.
